reference.title: Detailed Spatio-Temporal Reconstruction of Eyelids
reference.use: Treat lid contour, rolling skin, occlusion and eyelashes as a coherent deformation problem. Actual new arcs are art-directed source-index edits, not reconstructed individual anatomy or the authors algorithm.

sourceBasis: Pinned original r81B native wetline seams, original closed endpoint and actual displayed-skin triangle root frames; r60 source-local Catmull-Clark response/support construction reused for B.
notUsed: R85 crease/roll profiles, r86 shader-normal partition, r87 internal optics and a partially closed blink scalar as a new rest shape.
